metadata.purpose: Complete list of Cosmic Goals strings for translation

strings.fitness_Aries: 🏃 Aries: Your natural energy peaks in the morning. Use that Martian fire!
strings.mindfulness_Aries: 🧘 Aries: Challenge yourself to stay still. Your power grows in calm.
strings.wellness_Taurus: 🌿 Taurus: Your connection to nature is healing. Ground yourself.
strings.finance_Taurus: 💰 Taurus: Your patience with money is your greatest wealth.
strings.learning_Gemini: 📚 Gemini: Your curious mind absorbs everything. Channel that!
strings.social_Gemini: 👥 Gemini: Your communication gift connects people.
strings.relationships_Cancer: ❤️ Cancer: Your emotional depth creates lasting bonds.
strings.wellness_Cancer: 💧 Cancer: Water activities restore your lunar energy.
strings.creativity_Leo: 🎨 Leo: Your creative expression inspires others. Shine!
strings.leadership_Leo: 👑 Leo: Your generous heart makes you a natural leader.
strings.wellness_Virgo: 🌱 Virgo: Your attention to health details serves you well.
strings.service_Virgo: 🤝 Virgo: Your desire to help improves everything you touch.
strings.relationships_Libra: ⚖️ Libra: Your diplomatic nature creates harmony.
strings.wellness_Libra: 🌸 Libra: Balance is your path to inner peace.
strings.growth_Scorpio: 🦂 Scorpio: Your transformative power is profound.
strings.healing_Scorpio: 💜 Scorpio: Embrace deep healing. You are ready.
strings.adventure_Sagittarius: 🗺️ Sagittarius: Your explorer spirit knows no bounds!
strings.learning_Sagittarius: 📖 Sagittarius: Philosophy feeds your expansive mind.
strings.career_Capricorn: 🏔️ Capricorn: Your disciplined climb reaches the summit.
strings.finance_Capricorn: 💼 Capricorn: Long-term thinking is your superpower.
strings.growth_Aquarius: ⚡ Aquarius: Your innovative mind changes the world.
strings.creativity_Pisces: 🎨 Pisces: Your artistic soul channels divine inspiration.
strings.mindfulness_Pisces: 🌊 Pisces: Your spiritual connection is your guide.
strings.fitness: 💪 Movement is medicine. Your body thanks you!
strings.mindfulness: 🧘 Peace starts within. Breathe and center.
strings.wellness: 🌟 Self-care is not selfish. It is essential.
strings.learning: 📚 Every day is a chance to grow wiser.
strings.career: 🚀 Your professional growth shapes your future.
strings.healing: 💜 Healing takes courage. You have it.
strings.leadership: 👑 Lead with heart. Inspire with action.

strings.goals_empty_state: No goals yet. Generate some below!

placeholders.userSign: NEVER translate. Keep as {userSign}. Example: 'Goals for {userSign}' → 'Objectifs pour {userSign}'

emojis.rule: ALWAYS preserve emojis exactly as they appear

zodiac_signs.rule: Use proper zodiac name in target language
